import pathlib, re
D = pathlib.Path(".planning/phases/INS-24.4-cancelamento-por-linha-qual-linha-foi-cancelada-decide-o-con")

# ---- FIX A: waiter no molde do protocolo do projeto (sleep dentro de `timeout bash -c`) ----
PAT = re.compile(
    r"rm -f (?P<log>\S+\.log) (?P<rc>\S+\.rc); nohup sh -c '(?P<cmd>.*?)' >/dev/null 2>&1 & "
    r"i=0; until \[ -s (?P=rc) \] \|\| \[ \"\$i\" -ge (?P<n>\d+) \]; do sleep 10; i=\$\(\(i\+1\)\); done; "
)
def repl(m):
    teto = int(m.group("n")) * 10
    teto = 1800 if teto > 1000 else 900
    cmd = m.group("cmd").replace(" -q > ", " -ra -q > ")
    return (f"rm -f {m.group('log')} {m.group('rc')}; ( {cmd} ) & "
            f"timeout {teto} bash -c 'until [ -s {m.group('rc')} ]; do sleep 15; done'; ")

total = 0
for p in sorted(D.glob("24.4-0[1-7]-PLAN.md")):
    t = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    t2, n = PAT.subn(repl, t)
    if n:
        p.write_text(t2, encoding="utf-8")
        total += n
        print(f"waiter: {p.name} -> {n}")
print("TOTAL waiters trocados:", total)
PYEOF
